iwpc_full_6256.reason: Primary real-patient dataset: genotype + clinical covariates + therapeutic dose target.

iwpc_1780.reason: Secondary real-patient cohort with genotype, INR, and dose; use for validation (scaling differs from the 6256 cohort).

mimic3_demo.reason: Real (demo-scale) patients with warfarin Rx + INR trajectory + admission/diagnosis history; no genotype. Use for clinical-only validation.

mimic4_demo.reason: Real (demo-scale) MIMIC-IV patients (23) with warfarin Rx and INR labs; no genotype. Use for clinical-only validation alongside MIMIC-III.

eicu_crd_demo.reason: Has 160 real patient-stays with both a warfarin order and an INR/PT lab result; no genotype. Use for clinical-only validation alongside MIMIC-III/IV.

pharmgkb_allele_tables.reason: Curated variant-to-allele lookup tables for VKORC1/CYP2C9/CYP4F2; used for genotype interpretation, not as training rows.

population_allele_freq.reason: Population-level MAF context (1000 Genomes population_frequencies sheet plus Saudi NGS cohort), not per-patient data; excluded from the modeling pipeline.

faers_warfarin.reason: Spontaneous adverse-event reports: no genotype/INR/dose fields, not patient-linked to other cohorts. Not usable as a supervised training source; kept only for narrative safety discussion.

nomen_pk.reason: Simulated PK/PD data (Bjorkman model) from an external project; no real patients. SI-AIEP-paper kept only as methodology reference for SHAP-based explainability.

mipd_simulation.reason: Simulated cohort with simulator-assigned genotype and model-generated optimal-dose ground truth; not real patients. Useful only as an algorithm benchmark, not training data.
